binding.frame: local u,v in board plane; w positive out of F. Fsurface w=0; Bsurface w=-tBoard. Transform every recipe with final writer pose, do not reuse fixed world bounds after movement.

parameters.sF: actual seating lift above F; no sourced maximum
parameters.fB: maximum actual solder fillet projection beyond B
parameters.fF: maximum actual solder projection beyond F
parameters.mate: 095-902-570-006 right-angle SMA plug, keyed only by screw interface; clocking theta is free; final route must select it
parameters.Tmate: Mate from MIL-STD-348 SMA mating reference planes, not tip-to-tip, origin or visual overlap
parameters.tool: actual 8mm open wrench jaw/head solid plus handle, 11mm wrench at bulkhead; dimensions on 95-902-570-XXX revA. No inferred head OD or handle length.

recipes.class: drawing dimensional bound; independent tolerances; not model max
recipes.allowance: Any additional placement/case clearance must be explicitly default/advisory unless sourced.

recipes.shape: Union of four square-pin and signal-pin cylinders at pad-map centres, plus actual fillet solids; conservative XY may use pad-union as an advisory envelope. Relative B depth max(2.90-sF,fB).
recipes.class: source lead/board arithmetic plus unresolved fillet bound; cannot emit a qualified finite solid until fB and sF are bound

recipes.shape: Tboard*Tmate*Raxis(theta)*(actual plug solid plus dimensional tolerances); union with cable strain relief and swept cable tube
recipes.class: concrete mate selected, complete max shape and datum still unqualified; 10.50 REF on assembly drawing is not maximum

recipes.shape: Union of J2-F-mate translated along F normal from disconnected clear-start to fully seated; start travel determined by actual mating thread engagement, not an invented distance
Sweep actual 8mm open wrench jaw/head/handle around SMA axis through achievable tightening/regrip angles, plus counterhold fixture; never transmit cable tightening torque through solder pins
recipes.class: 8mm jaw is source dimension; all other tool dimensions/torque are unresolved

recipes.shape: For each of all five pads, sweep selected iron-tip/head solid from unobstructed B-side entry to actual fillet. Union with solder-wire approach and inspection line-of-sight; exclude case/floor/board supports until after soldering
recipes.class: phase sequencing and recipe; tool model and contact clearance require qualification

recipes.shape: Use selected cable bulkhead jack, supplied O-ring and washer/nut stack with one D-hole; seat O-ring on continuous compatible panel land. Counterhold at11mm and mate-tool8mm; strain-relieve inside. Only this jack crosses wall;132134 remains entirely inside.
recipes.class: local interface only; panel thickness, flatness/finish, seal compression, assembly torque and actual access must be bound before IP67 acceptance

acceptance: These recipes are writer inputs, not proof of packing, installed fit, vibration survival or ingress. Preserve no-metal ESP32 antenna region and all unrelated reservations.
